data.Name: Drogon — Schedule risk (FPSO and long-lead equipment)
data.Summary: FPSO conversion yard availability and subsea equipment lead times may delay first oil beyond the 2028-H1 target.
data.Description: Initial schedule risk assessment based on market screening. Only two qualifying FPSO conversion yards identified with available drydock slots in 2027. Subsea template fabrication requires 18–24 month lead time. Drilling rig market is tight with few semi-sub rigs available for 2027–2028. No SRA Monte Carlo schedule analysis performed yet. High likelihood of 6–12 month delay if contracting windows are missed. Mitigation strategy not yet developed — requires FEED engagement and dual-yard tendering.
